  external rotation of the hip, which recruits the gluteus maximus muscle more. The main stabilizers are the spinal erectors and latissimus dorsi. The lumbar erectors may also contract a little dynamically depending on the pelvic movement. The more the pelvis moves between APT and PPT the more active they will be. The elbow flexors stabilize the elbow. Common mistake, overextension of the lumbar spine while raising the legs, usually because of uncontrolled momentum. To prevent the extension, instruct the trainee to slightly contract the abdominal muscles while lifting the legs.
